title: Embedded Linux Engineer (Yocto Specialist)
description:
About Genesis 

Genesis is a physical AI lab and full-stack robotics company building general-purpose robots, with teams in Paris and the Bay Area. Our people have built some of the most widely used platforms in robotics research including the open-source Genesis simulator, pioneered generative simulation and led foundation-model work at some of the world's leading AI labs. We own the whole stack: hardware, embedded systems, simulation, data and robot foundation models.

The Role 

Every Genesis robot runs on a custom jetson thor compute board and every piece of software we write: control, perception, learned policies, depends on the Linux image underneath it. We are looking for a senior engineer to own that image end to end: build it, ship it to the robot, keep it updatable, and make it easy for the rest of the team to compile and deploy on top of it.

This is an in-house ownership role. You will be the reference for embedded Linux at Genesis, working closely with our embedded, robotics and application-software engineers in Paris and with our hardware partners. The job is to provide a reliable, well maintained and up to date os image, customized to our needs.

What You'll Do 

- Build, own and maintain the production Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution for our robot's custom board: BSP, kernel, device tree, rootfs, toolchain and custom layers.

- Bring up new hardware on NVIDIA Jetson-class platforms, integrating drivers and peripherals. Including hands-on debugging of components such as Wi-Fi, cameras, audio devices and buses on the physical robot.

- Own the full image lifecycle: reproducible builds, versioned releases, secure and robust over-the-air (OTA) updates, and long-term maintenance as hardware and software evolve.

- Deliver a development kit and workflow (SDK, cross-compilation, deployment tooling) so engineers can build and ship their software onto the robot quickly.

- Integrate GPU and AI-accelerator inference stacks so that our models run efficiently on the robot.

- Speed up the team's build and CI pipeline for image generation and validation. Builds are long, so caching and automation matter, as well as removing unnecessary dependencies.

- Document the system and make it approachable, so the image is never again a black box that only one person (or contractor) understands.

Your First Three Months 

- Build a custom Yocto image for the robot's custom boards.

- Flash, boot and validate it on real hardware, working through driver and integration issues on-site.

- Set up the cross compilation workflow, caching, CI automations to streamline the robotics team work

What You'll Bring 

- Passion for your craft and demonstrated excellence in embedded Linux engineering.

- 5+ years of hands-on embedded Linux experience, including shipping at least one Yocto-based image to production not only a prototype.

- Proven ownership of an image through its lifecycle: maintenance, release management and remote/OTA updates.

- Deep experience with Yocto internals: layers, recipes, BitBake, machine and distro configuration, SDK generation.

- Strong board bring-up and low-level debugging skills: kernel configuration, device trees, drivers, boot chain.

- Hands-on experience with the NVIDIA Jetson family (JetPack / L4T, meta-tegra) or comparable embedded GPU platforms.

- Knowledge C++ and Python packaging systems and how to deal with cross-compilation.

- The ability to explain how your work fits into the wider build, development and deployment system.

- Exceptional ownership and initiative, with the judgment to choose workable solutions for our current stage over the theoretically ideal one.

Bonus 

- Experience integrating GPU / AI-accelerator inference (CUDA, TensorRT or similar) on embedded targets.

- Background in robotics, drones, connected devices or other products with custom hardware.

- Experience working with chip vendors or ODMs.

- Familiarity with secure boot, real-time kernel tuning (PREEMPT_RT) or OTA frameworks such as Mender, RAUC or SWUpdate.

- French and English. Mandarin is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If You 

- Enjoy being the go-to person for a critical system and making it easier for others to use.

- Unblock teammates' requests quickly and pragmatically, and know when "good enough to ship" is the right answer.

- Stay patient and methodical when a single build takes two hours and a bug only shows up on hardware.

- Like startup flexibility: changing priorities, short feedback loops and work that ranges from kernel to tooling.

In this role, you’ll lead complex platform work from business context through production outcomes, combining hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, production ownership, and mentorship. In your first year, success means leading meaningful platform initiatives, improving reliability and developer experience, and becoming a trusted technical leader for the ML platform. 

At Oportun, we move fast and hold each other to a high bar. You’ll partner across Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering to solve ambiguous problems and move the needle for members and the business.

What You'll Do 

Your day-to-day 

- You’ll lead the design, implementation, deployment, and operation of complex platform capabilities that support the machine-learning lifecycle. 

- You’ll design scalable systems for model deployment and serving, feature computation, data validation, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and production support. 

- You’ll build reusable platform components, standards, and automation while improving reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness across ML systems. 

- You’ll partner with Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions.

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

- You’ll have 5+ years of professional software-engineering experience building and operating production systems, with strong programming skills in Python and deep knowledge of API design, distributed systems, service architecture, testing, and software-design fundamentals.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Singapore
description:
Who We Are 

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more .

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You’ll Do 

We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality.

You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab.

The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next.

Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder.

Five years from now, FDE at Roboflow on a resume should mean what a few years at Palantir or a FAANG company means. That's the bar we're hiring against.

Role and Responsibilities 

- 
0-to-1 Deployment: Take validated proof-of-concepts from the pre-sales process and build the first production deployment. This includes data pipeline setup, model optimization, edge device configuration, and integration with customer infrastructure.

- 
Edge-First Engineering: Deploy and operate computer vision systems on edge hardware in physical environments. Where conditions are unpredictable and connectivity is unreliable. This is hands-on, hardware-heavy work.

- 
Embed with Customers: Work on-site or deeply embedded with the customer’s engineering team during the initial deployment phase (typically 4–12 weeks per engagement). Build trust, transfer knowledge, and establish the foundation for long-term success.

- 
Production Engineering: Write production-grade code that will live in the customer’s environment. Handle the messy realities of real-world computer vision: lighting variability, camera calibration, model drift, network latency, and edge hardware constraints.

- 
Be Our Eyes and Ears in the Field: You'll be closer to the customer's real problems than anyone else at Roboflow. You'll surface the gap between what the customer says they want, what they actually need, and what the machine operators on the floor think. That feedback loop back to Product and Engineering shapes what we build next, and it's one of the most valuable things FDEs bring back to the company.

- 
Knowledge Transfer & Handoff: Document your deployment architecture, create runbooks, and train the customer’s team so they can operate the system independently. Provide a clean handoff to Roboflow’s Implementation Engineers for scaling and expansion.

- 
De-risk New Deployments: Identify and resolve technical risks early. If a customer’s environment won’t support the planned architecture, you find the alternative before it becomes a project failure.

- 
Shape the Deployment Playbook: Codify repeatable deployment patterns, starter templates, and reusable artifacts that make future deployments faster and more reliable.

The Skillset You’ll Bring 

- 
Meaningful experience deploying technology in physical-world environments. We value breadth, working across different industries, hardware platforms, and deployment contexts, over depth at a single company. The best FDEs we've hired have built things in factories, warehouses, construction sites, or labs before ever touching a vision model.

- 
Strong proficiency in Python; experience with systems-level work (Docker, Kubernetes, networking, Linux) is highly valued.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying machine learning or computer vision models to production; you understand the gap between a working notebook and a reliable pipeline.

- 
Experience with edge computing hardware and constraints (NVIDIA Jetson, industrial cameras, limited connectivity, on-premise security requirements).

- 
Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills; you’re the person who figures out why it works in staging but not in production.

- 
Strong interpersonal skills - you'll be embedded with customer teams and need to build trust quickly while navigating their internal dynamics. You'll talk to executives, engineers, and machine operators, sometimes in the same meeting.

- 
Experience in one or more of Roboflow’s target verticals: manufacturing, logistics, food processing, automotive, or retail.

- 
Willingness to travel ~40–50% for on-site customer deployments.

Preferred Attributes 

- 
Experience in a professional services, deployment engineering, or forward deployed engineering role.

- 
Familiarity with CV/MLOps tooling and practices (model versioning, monitoring, retraining pipelines).

- 
Deep industrial subject matter expertise. The kind of person who can walk onto a production line and immediately start asking the right questions about throughput, defect rates, and inspection points.

- 
Background in IoT, embedded systems, or infrastructure engineering alongside hands-on deployment experience.

- 
You're a tinkerer outside of work. You own a 3D printer, you've got Raspberry Pis running something in your house, you're constantly tweaking your home network or smart home setup. You enjoy figuring out why something doesn't work as much as you enjoy building it in the first place.

Who You’ll Be Working With 

Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll be partnering directly with our co-founder/CEO and Sales leadership to not only do great work in the role, but shape how this function works for the future of Roboflow.

Where You’ll Work 

This role is based in Singapore. You’ll be part of a distributed team that works closely across time zones, with regular opportunities to get together in person (like team onsites in different cities) and a $4000 USD/yr travel stipend to make those trips happen. Work from home, from a co-working space, or wherever you do your best work. We want you to work where you work best!

When You’ll Work 

Roboflow’s core team is largely US-based, so you’ll have a small number of synchronous meetings each week that fall outside standard Singapore hours (typically early morning or evening SGT). Beyond that, your schedule follows your customers and your deployments, and we work asynchronously with the rest of the team.

What You’ll Receive 

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits:

- 
$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

- 
$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

- 
$350/mo AI Tools

- 
$150/mo Team lunch

- 
$500/one time Home office

- 
Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (~5 hours) 

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team, who you’ll be speaking directly with about what it’s like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don’t be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a few days.

Before the Interview: 

- 
We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc.

- 
The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

- 
We may send you a technical screen if applicable.

Introduction Phase: 

- 
[45m] Meet with hiring manager to assess for overall mindset and skillset

Team Interview Phase: 

- 
[60m] Technical Assessment - live coding or architecture session

- 
[30m] Demo - build a project with Roboflow and share your work

Final Interview Stage: 

- 
[30m] Meet with Head of Operations, for a culture discussion

- 
[30m] Meet with Joseph Nelson, CEO

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can. 

Not Sure If This Is You? 

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing “Subscribe” to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us 

We are building a diverse Distributed team that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

We provide competitive compensation and stellar benefits to accelerate your personal and work life. Learn more about what it is like to work at Roboflow by reading these blog posts .

Equal Employment Opportunity 

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

description:

Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen.

Mit wem du arbeitest

Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet.

Erik hat Consulting einmal komplett durchgespielt, zuletzt als Business Unit Manager Data & AI bei Reply Enterprise Consulting. Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah.

Du bist unsere erste Einstellung und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den Hack, der einen Skill doppelt so gut macht.

Was du bei uns machst

- Du baust AI-Systeme für unsere Kunden: Agenten, AI-Plattformen, Software Factories. Von der Architektur bis zum Betrieb.
- Du arbeitest an Strategieprojekten mit, in denen Unternehmen zu Builder Companies werden.
- Du arbeitest agentisch. Coding Agents sind bei uns das Standardwerkzeug für fast alles.
- Du probierst aus, was im AI-Umfeld neu erscheint, und bringst das Brauchbare in unsere Projekte.
- Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unseren eigenen Produkten und Ventures.
Was du mitbringst

- AI ist dein Beruf und dein Hobby, und das schon seit Jahren. Du warst dabei, bevor es jeder war.
- Wenn im AI-Umfeld etwas Neues erscheint, hast du es ausprobiert, bevor andere davon gelesen haben. Egal ob Modell, Tool, Framework oder Hardware.
- Du baust lieber, als darüber zu reden.
- Du hast Berufserfahrung. Ob 1 Jahr oder 8: Mindset und Fundament zählen mehr als Jahre.
- Erfahrung mit Google Cloud ist ein Plus.
- Du willst jeden Tag dazulernen und kannst mit Feedback umgehen.
- Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.
Was dich erwartet

- Keine Limits beim Werkzeug. Tokens, Hardware, Software: Du bekommst, was du für sehr gute Arbeit brauchst. Wir sehen das als Arbeitsmittel und diskutieren nicht über Budgets.
- Kunden mit Anspruch. Konzerne und große Mittelständler, die wirklich umbauen wollen, Private-Equity-Portfolios und Startups. Strategie für Builder Companies, Software Factories und AI-Plattformen, dazu die Umsetzung mit sichtbarer Wirkung im Kundengeschäft.
- Eigene Produkte und Ventures. Wir bauen neben dem Kundengeschäft eigene Produkte auf. Wer früh dabei ist, kann dort eine entscheidende Rolle übernehmen.
- Büro in der HafenCity. Wir arbeiten jeden Tag zusammen vor Ort, mit Blick über die ganze Stadt.
Das passt nicht, wenn

- du lieber allein im Homeoffice sitzt, als mit uns zusammen zu bauen.
- du klare Prozesse und ein fertiges Ticket-Board erwartest.
- du AI für einen Hype hältst.
So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und drei Sätze dazu, wie du AI in deinem Alltag nutzt. Fragen an ----- oder ----- geht's weiter

- 30 Minuten Call
- Ein halber Tag bei uns in der HafenCity: schnacken, essen, zusammen etwas bauen
- Danach entscheiden wir. Ja oder nein, schnell.

title: CAD scripting Expert
description:
Headquarters: 

Overview

We are building evaluation benchmarks that test whether AI agents can complete real professional work from start to finish. We are hiring expert mechanical design and CAD automation engineers to turn real, paid CAD tasks from their own work into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the files and systems it runs on, a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning real, paid mechanical CAD work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.

• Define each task precisely, including the files, systems and environment it runs on, so an AI agent can attempt it without ambiguity or hidden assumptions.

• Write a working reference solution using scripted CAD, such as FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, that rebuilds parametric parts correctly after parameters change.

• Build automated checks and tests that prove the result is objectively correct, covering geometry, dimensions, tolerances and file outputs such as STEP or IGES.

• Calibrate difficulty so each task takes an expert about 60-75 minutes to solve, and explain how a real-world mistake would be caught by the checks.

• Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, documenting the design intent, tools, data and rules used so others can reproduce and validate your work.

Skills/Experience

• 3+ years designing real mechanical parts that were manufactured or shipped, doing the hands-on work yourself (not only studying, selling, managing or teaching it)

• Hands-on CAD work within the last 3 years, with the ability to name the systems, tools, data and rules you used

• Builds or modifies designs through scripts (FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, OpenSCAD, Onshape FeatureScript), not only through GUI work

• Reads engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T, and can explain how a design mistake would be caught

• Technical fluency with Python or another language and the command line, plus files such as CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

• Availability to start around early November 2026 and take on tasks on a flexible, task-based schedule

Nice-to-have

• Parametric design-intent experience

• Open-source hardware contributions or projects

• Docker and Git experience

• Experience writing automated tests

• Experience with SolidWorks, Fusion or Onshape APIs and STEP/IGES workflows

Process

• Task-based vetting: you complete a vetting task instead of an interview

• Paid per task, with each task taking about 60-75 minutes to solve

• Flexible, task-based work cadence, with an expected start around early November 2026

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-cad-scripting-expert

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Service Standards
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Senior Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will help shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across Vinted. You will be a key contributor to the development of our standards and a core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.

You will be part of the Service Standards team in a Service Ecosystem domain, Platform Unit, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.

The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. In this role, you will focus on deep technical execution, building reusable frameworks, and helping establish backend best practices and golden paths for product developers across Vinted.

You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

- Contribute to the technical design and development of company-wide service standards and golden paths.

- Build and maintain reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.

- Implement robust consumer API contracts, standardized startup patterns, and performance tooling into foundational frameworks.

- Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates, collect feedback, and improve developer experience.

- Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices directly into standard service templates.

- Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.

- Participate in technical design reviews, RFCs, and code reviews, fostering high engineering standards within the team.

- Help write clear documentation and guidelines to empower engineers across Vinted to adopt golden paths effortlessly.

About you 

- Strong backend engineering experience with solid system design skills and hands-on experience building scalable services.

- Practical expertise in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.

- Passionate about developer experience, tooling, and enabling other engineers through well-designed software.

- Ability to evaluate pragmatic technical trade-offs between code maintainability, delivery speed, and technical debt.

- Communicates technical concepts clearly and collaborates constructively across multidisciplinary teams.

- Enjoys sharing knowledge, participating in design discussions, and driving continuous technical improvements.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Frequent team-building events

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per working day

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

- NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

- Company bike leasing scheme

- Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

- Work from Home allowance 

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:

€76.800 — €104.000 EUR

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

description:

Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26

About Edconic 

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role 

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do 

- Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.

- Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.

- Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.

- Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.

- Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring 

- 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.

- The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.

The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.

In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.

What you’ll do 

- Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.

- Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.

- Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.

- Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.

- Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team.

- Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.

- Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.

- Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).

What you’ll bring 

- Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups).

- Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase.

- Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.

- Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time.

- Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.

- A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems).

- Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.

- Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team.

About the team 

GitLab Orbit sits within the Data Engineering organization. We work closely with partners across AI (Duo Agent Platform), analytics, infrastructure and delivery, and security because our work spans many parts of the platform.

title: The Jump: Fast-Track Programme
description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here .

The Jump: 

The Jump is Omnea's 12-month programme for ambitious engineers who want to make the jump to senior, faster than they could elsewhere. You'll join one of our product teams as a Product Engineer and take on progressively bigger, harder work, with the support to grow into it.

Plenty of companies promise fast progression. We back it with structure:

- Real scope. Ship from week one, own a feature end to end in your first quarter, and lead a project with one or two other engineers by months 6–9.

- A buddy for the year. An experienced engineer from another team, not your manager, who meets you every month for the full 12 months and talks you through how they make decisions.

- Six practical sessions in your first six months. Live, in-person sessions across two Jump Day afternoons, covering impact, autonomy, product and design, customers, commercial and influence. Each is built around a real Omnea project and applied straight to your own work. No bootcamp.

- Honest feedback. A monthly self-review talked through with your buddy, and a quarterly progression review with your team lead, so you always know where you stand.

- Promotion when you're ready. As soon as you're consistently operating at the next level, judged against the same bar as everyone else. Not held for an annual review.

What Success Looks Like:

We expect you to be operating at the next level within about 12 months. We'll give you the scope, the buddy and the feedback, so you can drive your progression as fast and as far as you can. We'll track your progress together through structured checkpoints across the year, so you always know where you stand.

Our bar is high. Our levels mean more here than at most companies, and promotion is judged on how you operate, not on finishing a programme.

What We're Looking For:

- You're proactive. You spot problems and fix them, or get them to the right person, without being asked. You keep people updated rather than waiting to be chased.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description:
Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. 

Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen? 

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

- Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

- Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

- Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

- Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen 

Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan:

- KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen.

- Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam.

- Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act.

Wat breng je mee? 

- Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit.

- Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

- Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

- Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

- Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

- Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen.

Wat dit níet is 

- Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

- Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

- Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

- Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team 

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. 

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk 

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

- Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

- AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

- adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen 

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons? 

- €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

- 8% vakantiegeld;

- Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

- Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

- 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

- €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

- Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

- Goede pensioenregeling;

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

- Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken? 

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Applied AI Engineer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About BJAK 

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You'll Own 

- Build AI-powered workflows, assistants, agents and automation systems.

- Apply AI across customer support, CRM, onboarding, claims, renewals, payments, operations and internal tools.

- Work with product and engineering teams to turn manual processes into scalable AI-native systems.

- Build integrations with LLMs, internal data, APIs, documents, knowledge bases and business systems.

- Design evaluation, monitoring and fallback flows so AI outputs are useful, safe and reliable.

- Prototype quickly, test with users or operators, then productionize what works.

- Improve speed, quality and consistency across workflows using AI where it creates real business value.

What We're Looking For 

- Strong software engineering foundation, preferably with Python and backend systems.

- Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agents, RAG, workflow automation or AI tools.

- Able to connect AI systems with real product, data and operational workflows.

- Good judgement on where AI helps and where rule-based systems or human review are better.

- Understands evaluation, accuracy, latency, cost, privacy and failure modes.

- Fast builder who can prototype, test and ship practical systems.

- Experience in fintech, insurance, support automation, CRM or operations automation is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want 

- Practical AI builder, not just a prompt experimenter.

- Thinks in workflows, systems and measurable quality.

- Can build quickly but still cares about guardrails and reliability.

- Comfortable working with messy real-world data and processes.

- Honest about what AI can and cannot do.

This Role Is Not For 

- People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

- Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

- Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

- People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

- Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

Location 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany. 

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Ops
description:
About Cantina: 

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!

About the Role: 

We are looking for an ML Engineer to own the production inference stack for our text-to-speech (TTS) and speech recognition (ASR) models, end to end. Our research team delivers trained model checkpoints; you will productionize them as low-latency, real-time streaming services that run cost-efficiently on GPUs. The role covers the inference engines, the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and the performance benchmarking and accuracy validation that let us ship changes safely. You will bridge research and production, and own latency, throughput, cost and accuracy as we scale.

What You’ll Do: 

- 
Build and optimize streaming inference engines for TTS and ASR models, including multi-stage model pipelines.

- 
Optimize latency (time to first chunk, p50/p99) and throughput using continuous batching, CUDA Graphs, torch.compile and mixed precision.

- 
Maintain numerical parity with the reference implementation through automated accuracy regression tests, per stage and end to end.

- 
Deploy and operate GPU inference services on Kubernetes: autoscaling, containerization and infrastructure as code.

- 
Build CI/CD for model artifacts, with model versioning and reproducible releases.

- 
Own observability and performance benchmarking: p50/p99 latency, real-time factor (RTF), GPU utilization and cost per request.

- 
Partner with research to productionize new models.

What You’ll Bring: 

- 
Hands-on experience deploying, scaling and optimizing ML models in production, beyond consuming model APIs.

- 
Working knowledge of the full inference stack, from CUDA kernels to serving frameworks, with depth in some layers; expertise across all of them is not expected.

- 
GPU performance optimization: profiling (Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler), memory bandwidth, CPU-GPU synchronization.

- 
Solid understanding of model serving: continuous batching, KV cache management, request scheduling.

- 
Production experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch, and a rigorous approach to performance benchmarking.

- 
Experience with speech or audio models (TTS, ASR, voice conversion).

- 
Experience with inference frameworks such as vLLM (vLLM-Omni), SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT or Triton Inference Server.

Compensation: 

When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

Benefits for U.S.-based roles: 

- 
Competitive salary and generous company equity

- 
Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina

- 
42 days of paid time off, including:

- 
15 PTO days

- 
10 sick days

- 
15 company holidays

- 
2 floating holidays

- 
Generous parental leave & fertility support

- 
401(k) retirement savings plan

- 
Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like

- 
Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees

- 
One Medical membership, and more!

title: Senior Software Engineer, Processing
description:
Headquarters: Remote 

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

Position: Senior Software Engineer, Processing

Location: Remote

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.

The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.

What you'll do: 

- Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services

- Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces

- Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt

- Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements

- Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way

- Participate in the team on-call rotation

- Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering

- Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager

What you'll bring: 

- 8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments

- Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills

- Experience driving large cross-functional projects across engineering, product, and operations teams

- A proven commitment to empathy and inclusion

- Excellent communication skills

- Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve is a must

- You’ll partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to improve capacity planning, platform performance, cost visibility, and resource optimization. 

- You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve troubleshooting, documentation, incident response, and operational efficiency. 

Who You Are 

The right fit looks like this 

You’re a hands-on platform engineer who enjoys solving complex production problems and improving the systems behind critical data workloads. You think beyond the immediate issue, look for root causes, and build solutions that make the platform more reliable and easier to operate. 

You’re comfortable working across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, databases, automation, and security. You communicate clearly during incidents, take ownership through resolution, and consistently look for ways to reduce repetitive work and improve operational maturity. 

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

Required 

- Strong experience supporting production data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DataOps environments. 

- Hands-on experience administering and supporting Databricks, including workspaces, jobs, workflows, compute, cluster policies, and access controls. 

- Experience supporting Spark, Delta Lake, and Delta Live Tables workloads. 

- Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, security groups, CloudWatch, and networking. 

- Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise or similar tools. 

- Experience supporting MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB in production environments. 

- Strong understanding of monitoring, observability, alerting, and incident-management practices. 

- Experience with CI/CD, Git, GitHub Actions, and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages. 

- Experience troubleshooting platform performance, connectivity, permissions, certificates, TLS, and integration issues. 

- Experience with production support, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and on-call operations. 

- Strong understanding of security and access concepts such as IAM, RBAC, secrets management, certificates, and secure connectivity. 

- Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. 

Nice to Have 

- Experience with Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Databricks CLI, REST APIs, and Databricks asset or deployment bundles. 

- Experience with Kubernetes administration and production troubleshooting. 

- Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms. 

- Experience with Rootly or similar incident-management platforms. 

- Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Ops Manager, or comparable MongoDB tooling. 

- Experience with MariaDB/MySQL replication, schema migrations, indexing, backup validation, and restore procedures. 

- Experience with capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and workload performance tuning. 

- Experience implementing or improving data governance, compliance controls, or audit processes. 

- Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve operations, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation. 

Our AI Mindset 

We build with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

title: Growth Operations Engineer
description:
Title: Growth Operations Engineer 

Peerspace is the leading and category defining online marketplace for venue rentals for meetings, productions, and events. We open doors to the most inspiring spaces around the world, from lofts and mansions to storefronts and studios. Over $500M has been transacted through the platform, and our investors include GV (Google Ventures) and Foundation Capital.

Our people are the heart of Peerspace. We are a team that values inclusion and working cross functionally. Our strategy and objectives are clear and we support one another to exceed expectations. We believe that a healthy company culture creates an environment where people are excited to come into work everyday and contribute to building a successful organization. 

The Role: 

As a Growth Operations Engineer at Peerspace, you will be the driving force behind scaling and optimizing our operational infrastructure through systematic innovation and growth hacking. This role sits at the critical intersection of business operations, process optimization, and technical automation. You will architect and implement scalable solutions that transform our customer operations, trust and safety, and sales workflows from manual processes into efficient, automated systems. Your mission is to identify operational bottlenecks, design data-driven solutions, and build robust technical infrastructure that enables exponential growth while maintaining service quality.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and deploy systems that not only streamline current operations but also create new capabilities for rapid scaling. Your work will directly impact our ability to handle increasing customer volume while reducing operational costs and improving team efficiency through smart automation and process optimization.

Responsibilities: 

- 
Systems Integration: Design, implement, and maintain integrations between key operational systems and our product infrastructure. Create automated workflows that enhance efficiency and data accuracy across platforms.

- 
Technical Support Infrastructure: Develop and optimize internal tools that empower our customer support and trust & safety teams to respond faster and more effectively to user needs. This includes building custom solutions for case management, automated responses, and support analytics.

- 
AI Implementation: Architect and implement AI-powered solutions to enhance customer support efficiency, including automated response systems, intelligent ticket routing, and predictive analytics for customer issues.

- 
Data Analytics: Create and maintain dashboards and reporting systems that provide real-time insights into customer support metrics, team performance, and system health. Use data to identify areas for automation and improvement.

- 
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure seamless integration of support systems with our core product. Partner with customer success and trust & safety teams to understand their needs and implement effective solutions.

- 
Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and improve support workflows, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency gains through technical solutions.

Requirements: 

- 
Technical Skills: Strong programming experience with proficiency in SQL and at least one modern programming language (Python, JavaScript, etc.). Experience with Laravel and Nuxt/Vue preferred. Experience with API integrations and webhook implementations.

- 
Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with customer support platforms (Intercom preferred), CRM systems, and ancillary software (MixMax, Zapier, Outreach, etc). Understanding of modern SaaS architecture and integration patterns.

- 
LLM/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI platforms and their practical applications in customer support contexts. Experience implementing and managing AI-powered solutions is a plus.

- 
Operations Background: 3+ years of experience in technical operations, customer operations, or similar roles where you've built or maintained support systems at scale.

- 
Analysis & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and visualization tools. Ability to translate complex operational problems into technical solutions.

- 
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- 
Customer Focus: Deep understanding of customer support operations and how technology can enhance the customer experience.

Working At Peerspace 

The annual salary range for this role is $110,000 to $120,000. The actual salary amount will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data.

Peerspace is proudly certified as a Great Place to Work™ and we're a remote first company with team members located in cities around the globe. Beyond competitive salary and equity compensation, we provide a range of benefits and perks, including:

● 100% employee coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

● Discount on all Peerspace bookings

● Laptop, high res display, and stipend to setup home office

● Monthly cell phone and internet credit

● Annual In person all company offsite and team-building events (in Peerspace locations, of course)

● Wellness Days observed company wide

Diversity 

At Peerspace, we're dedicated to creating a team that's diverse, equitable and inclusive. Our workplace is a space where all team members are empowered to blaze their own trail, make things happen, and take pride in their work. We believe bringing people together from different backgrounds and identities makes us stronger and better serves the Peerspace community. We'd especially like to encourage applicants from different backgrounds, locations, and experiences.

At Peerspace, we are committed to maintaining a secure and transparent hiring experience. Please be aware that scammers sometimes impersonate companies like ours by posting fake job listings or reaching out to job seekers in misleading ways. All legitimate communication from Peerspace will come from an official @peerspace.com email address. We do not contact candidates through personal email accounts, third-party messaging apps such as WhatsApp or Microsoft Teams, or through the Peerspace platform's internal messaging system. All interviews are conducted only by phone or Zoom, and we will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information such as your Social Security number or bank details during the early stages of the hiring process. If you receive any message that seems suspicious or does not align with these practices, please contact us immediately at help@peerspace.com so we can investigate. We only post our job openings and process applications, through our official careers page at https://jobs.lever.co/peerspace .

If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. 

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. 

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. - Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. 

- Deep JavaScript and React . 

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique. 

Preferred: 

- Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source .
